acha.hi: Aaj subah se baarish ho rahi hai.
acha.en: It's been raining since morning.

acha.hi: Mera phone charge nahi ho raha.
acha.en: My phone isn't charging.

acha.hi: Charger hai kya tere paas?
acha.en: Do you have a charger?

acha.hi: Kal movie dekhne chalein?
acha.en: Shall we go watch a movie tomorrow?

acha.hi: Tickets maine book kar liye.
acha.en: I've booked the tickets.

acha.hi: Mujhe thoda late ho jaayega.
acha.en: I'll be a little late.

acha.hi: Tu shuru kar, main aa raha hoon.
acha.en: You start, I'm on my way.

acha.hi: Aaj kya banaya hai khaane mein?
acha.en: What's been made for food today?

acha.hi: Mummy ne rajma chawal banaye hain.
acha.en: Mum made rajma chawal.

acha.hi: Wah, mera favourite!
acha.en: Wow, my favourite!

acha.hi: Gym jaana shuru kiya kya?
acha.en: Have you started going to the gym?

acha.hi: Haan, par roz nahi jaa paata.
acha.en: Yes, but I can't go every day.

acha.hi: Kal raat neend nahi aayi.
acha.en: I couldn't sleep last night.

acha.hi: Bahut der tak phone chala raha tha.
acha.en: I was on my phone till very late.

acha.hi: Is baar Diwali pe ghar gaya tha?
acha.en: Did you go home for Diwali this time?

acha.hi: Nahi yaar, chhutti nahi mili.
acha.en: No man, I didn't get leave.

acha.hi: Koi achhi series bata na.
acha.en: Suggest a good series, na.

acha.hi: Maine abhi naya episode dekha.
acha.en: I just watched the new episode.

acha.hi: Spoiler mat dena!
acha.en: Don't give spoilers!

acha.hi: Mujhe ek kaam yaad dila dena.
acha.en: Remind me of one thing.

acha.hi: Kal bank jaana zaroori hai.
acha.en: I really need to go to the bank tomorrow.

acha.hi: Itna bhaari bag kyun uthaya hai?
acha.en: Why are you carrying such a heavy bag?

acha.hi: Laao, main madad kar deta hoon.
acha.en: Here, let me help.

acha.hi: Thank you, tu sach mein achha dost hai.
acha.en: Thank you, you're a really good friend.

bahut.hi: Yaar, aaj toh din hi kharab nikla.
bahut.en: Man, today just turned out to be a bad day.

bahut.hi: Subah se ek ke baad ek musibat aa rahi hai.
bahut.en: One problem after another since morning.

bahut.hi: Koi na, kal naya din hoga.
bahut.en: No worries, tomorrow is a new day.

bahut.hi: Tujhse milke dil khush ho gaya.
bahut.en: Meeting you made my day.

bahut.hi: Itne dinon baad dikha, sab khairiyat?
bahut.en: Seeing you after so long, all well?

bahut.hi: Bas, zindagi chal rahi hai apni raftaar se.
bahut.en: Just, life is going at its own pace.

bahut.hi: Mujhe toh ab aadat si ho gayi hai.
bahut.en: I've kind of got used to it now.

bahut.hi: Baat toh sahi hai teri, par maanega kaun?
bahut.en: You're right, but who's going to agree?

bahut.hi: Usko samjhana deewar se baat karne jaisa hai.
bahut.en: Explaining to him is like talking to a wall.

bahut.hi: Chhod na, uska kuch nahi ho sakta.
bahut.en: Forget it, nothing can be done about him.

bahut.hi: Paise ki fikar mat kar, main dekh lunga.
bahut.en: Don't worry about money, I'll sort it.

bahut.hi: Aaj kal mehangai ne toh kamar tod di hai.
bahut.en: These days rising prices have broken our backs.

bahut.hi: Sach bolun toh mujhe bhi dar lag raha tha.
bahut.en: Honestly, I was scared too.

bahut.hi: Jab tak main hoon, tension kis baat ki?
bahut.en: As long as I'm here, why worry?

bahut.hi: Woh toh aankhon ka taara hai sabka.
bahut.en: He's everyone's favourite (the apple of their eye).

bahut.hi: Kya baat hai, aaj toh chamak rahe ho!
bahut.en: Wow, you're looking sharp today!

bahut.hi: Bas, naya kurta liya tha, socha pehen loon.
bahut.en: Just bought a new kurta, thought I'd wear it.

bahut.hi: Pehle kaam, phir aaram.
bahut.en: Work first, then rest.

bahut.hi: Itni jaldi kya hai, baith na thodi der.
bahut.en: What's the rush, sit for a while.

bahut.hi: Chai pe charcha ho jaaye?
bahut.en: Shall we chat over tea?

bahut.hi: Tera kaam toh ekdum jhakaas tha.
bahut.en: Your work was totally awesome.

bahut.hi: Mujhe yakeen nahi ho raha ki yeh sach hai.
bahut.en: I can't believe this is real.

bahut.hi: Jo hoga dekha jaayega.
bahut.en: Whatever happens, we'll see.

bahut.hi: Milte rehna, bhoolna mat.
bahut.en: Keep meeting up, don't forget me.
